subject: Throughput-based reserve pricing — follow-up & numbers request
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput-based reserve pricing — follow-up & numbers request

Hi Elena — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a reserve and give you an apples-to-apples $/1M token comparison across GPU families.

Call highlights (my notes):
- Primary workload: mixed chat + extraction pipelines, avg context ~1.5k tokens, ~35% of requests include tool calls (external lookup).
- Current baseline: ~800k tokens/day on average; peak days hit ~1.1M tokens.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for chat flows.
- Security: VPC + SOC2 required, you indicated Contract + PO cadence in Q3.

Can you confirm the following so we can model unit economics?
1) Expected committed throughput: are you thinking in tokens/month (preferred) or GPUs/reserved capacity? If tokens, rough bands (e.g., 25M / 100M / 300M monthly).
2) Peak concurrency or requests/sec we should design for (you mentioned some spikes in morning batch).
3) Preferred GPU family (A100 80GB, A100 40GB, H100) — internal infra preference vs strict requirement?
4) Target blended $/1M tokens you need us to be near to sign (ballpark range is fine).

If easier, paste answers inline and we’ll run 3 reserve scenarios (pilot 2-GPU, scale 4-GPU, scale 12-GPU) and show projected $/1M token at the throughput targets and latency SLO.

Attaching a short worksheet and our latest dedicated pricing deck (v3) — the worksheet will let you plug your exact daily profile.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v3.pdf (12 pages), orion_throughput_modeling.xlsx (workbook)
From: Elena Park <elena.park@orionanalytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@orionanalytics.com>, procurement@orionanalytics.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput-based reserve pricing — follow-up & numbers request

Hi Aditya / Marissa / Laura — thanks for the recap. Confirming numbers below so you can model.

1) Commit preference: tokens/month. Our internal forecast for Q3–Q4: baseline ~25M tokens/month, expected growth to ~80M tokens/month within 6 months if latency and cost hit targets. We can start with a two-step commit: pilot (25M/mo) -> scale (80M/mo).
2) Peak: our telemetry shows peak sustained bursts ~120 reqs/sec during ingestion windows; typical concurrency for chat flows is 30–60 concurrent requests. Average response length ~450 tokens; generation-only portion ~40% of full context.
3) GPU family: preference for A100 80GB due to existing internal validation; open to H100 if there9s a clear latency/price win. For now please model both A100-80 and H100.
4) Target blended $/1M tokens: procurement target is $7–9 / 1M tokens for committed volume at scale (80M). For the pilot we can accept higher $/1M as long as we have a clear path to the target on scale.

Procurement note: PO process takes ~3 weeks once we have a formal quote + SOW; SOC2 + IP addendum are on file. Devon will coordinate the PO.

Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Orion Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput-based reserve pricing — follow-up & numbers request

Thanks Elena — very helpful. I attached two outputs:
- Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v3.pdf (high level pricing bands and terms)
- orion_throughput_modeling.xlsx (populated with your numbers, three scenarios)

Summary of our modeling (top-line):
- Pilot: 1x A100-80GB reserved equivalent (2-GPU effective throughput) sized for 25M tokens/month, estimated p95 ~280ms for chat flows. Indicative committed price: $18,500/mo (~$22.5 / 1M tokens during pilot).
- Scale (A100-80GB): 4x reserved lanes (effective GPU pool sizing to hit ~80M tokens/mo with headroom for peaks). Indicative committed price: $44,000/mo -> ~ $5.5 / 1M tokens at 80M tokens/mo (blended after batching & caching).
- Scale (H100): 3x reserved lanes (H100 gives higher throughput per GPU). Indicative committed price: $52,500/mo -> ~ $6.2 / 1M tokens at 80M tokens/mo.

Notes on assumptions and levers that materially change $/1M: batching window (we modeled 15–30ms continuous batching), prefix KV cache hit rate (~18%), and model variant (we assumed the open-model variant you demoed). If you expect higher cache hits or lower avg context, $/1M drops further.

Next steps we propose:
1) You sign off on preferred GPU family (A100-80 or H100) and target commit band (pilot 25M -> scale 80M).
2) We prepare a formal quote + SOW (1–2 business days once we have the commitment band).
3) Pilot kickoff: 2-week PoP where we validate p95 SLA and throughput; pilot invoice at pilot committed monthly rate pro-rated.

Questions for you:
- Is a two-step commit (pilot -> scale) acceptable from procurement?
- Any internal constraints on GPU family (e.g., security, specific firmware)?

If you9d like, we can also run a quick sensitivity with your exact daily token distribution; I already put your numbers into the attached sheet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v3.pdf, orion_throughput_modeling.xlsx
From: Elena Park <elena.park@orionanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@orionanalytics.com>, procurement@orionanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput-based reserve pricing — follow-up & numbers request

Marissa / Aditya — thanks for the clear modeling and the workbook. A few quick confirmations from our side:
- Two-step commit is acceptable. We9d prefer to sign the pilot (25M/mo) and include a 90-day scale trigger to move to 80M/mo if SLOs are met.
- GPU family: we9ll plan for A100-80GB for the pilot. Procurement asked that you also include an H100 option in the formal quote for comparison.
- Pricing target: procurement asks whether Redwood can reach a blended $7 / 1M tokens at 80M commit (we saw your A100 model at $5.5 / 1M — can you confirm the assumptions that get you to $5.5 and whether there9s room to tighten to $6.5–7 with a 12–month commit?).

Action items for Redwood (requested):
1) Formal quote + SOW including both A100 and H100 scale options and a 90-day scale trigger for pilot -> scale.
2) Pilot PO template (procurement wants the approximate PO line items to start internal approvals).
3) Short note on the batching/cache assumptions and how they change the blended $/1M — this will go into our internal procurement memo.

If you can get the formal quote and PO template to Devon and procurement by EOD Wednesday (5 Aug), we9ll start the PO approval path.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Orion Analytics
